kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ظَبْي • (ẓaby) m (plural أَظْبٍ (ʔaẓbin, construct state أَظْبِي (ʔaẓbī)) or ظِبَاء (ẓibāʔ) or ظُبِيّ (ẓubiyy), feminine ظَبْيَة (ẓabya))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Inherited from Proto-Semitic *θ̣aby-. Compare Aramaic טַבְיָא (ṭaḇyā), Classical Syriac ܛܒܝܐ (ṭaḇyā), Hebrew צְבִי (ts'ví, ṣəḇī), Ugaritic 𐎑𐎁𐎊 (ẓby).
